overall_goal: Crush biscuits in a food processor, measure them into a bowl, and combine them with the heated date mixture

goals.rationale: The person retrieves the food processor components, plugs in the motor, and assembles the bowl and blade.

goals.description: Add the first batch of biscuits to the food processor
goals.rationale: The person opens a package of biscuits and empties its contents into the food processor bowl.

goals.description: Open a new packet of biscuits and discard the empty packaging
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a new packet of biscuits, opens it, and throws the empty packaging into the waste bin.

goals.description: Add the second batch of biscuits to the food processor
goals.rationale: The person adds more biscuits from the newly opened packet into the food processor bowl.

goals.description: Crush the biscuits using the food processor
goals.rationale: The person places the lid on the food processor and operates it to crush the biscuits into smaller pieces.

goals.description: Measure the crushed biscuits into a bowl
goals.rationale: The person prepares a bowl and a glass, then pours the crushed biscuits from the food processor into the glass to measure them before emptying them into the bowl.

goals.description: Transfer the date mixture from the pot to the biscuit bowl
goals.rationale: The person removes the pot of dates from the heat and pours the sticky date mixture into the bowl containing the crushed biscuits.
